james.sales: Hey finance team — heads up: NimbusEdge asked for a pilot billing carveout. Looking for approval to apply a split billing structure for months 1-3 and a one-time pilot credit.

marta.finance: Can you drop the numbers? need ARR, expected monthly tokens, and proposed credit amount.

james.sales: Yep. ARR for their project ~$240k over 12mo. Expected avg monthly usage month1=1.2B tokens, month2=900M, month3=700M. Proposal: 50/50 split invoicing between Hosted API rate and Dedicated commit for first 3 months, plus a $18,000 pilot credit applied on month1 invoice.

leo.revops: Quick Q — is the 50/50 split just an invoicing construct or are we actually provisioning dedicated capacity?

james.sales: It's invoicing only for now. We'll reserve a soft commit with Dedicated team so they get predictable perf, but we won't spin up dedicated until month2 unless they exceed X. It's more of a pricing allocation for the initial billing periods.

marta.finance: If it's invoice-only, we need to treat it as a pricing exception. That $18k credit looks like ~7.5% of ARR. Need deal desk approval + run impact on revenue recognition.

aditya.legal: I need to confirm contract language allows credits against first invoice and any special billing splits. Also confirm there are no passthrough hardware commitments. Can sales get a draft SOW or amendment?

james.sales: I can attach a draft amendment today. Also asking for Net30 terms (customer prefers Net60 but sales pushed Net30).

marta.finance: Net30 is fine for pilot but add a clause: credit forfeited if contract canceled before month4.

leo.revops: For accounting — how do we map token usage to SKUs for revenue? We need a mapping rule: tokens attributed to Dedicated commit up to commit_k tokens, rest billed Hosted.
marta.finance: Suggest mapping: for months 1-3 allocate 50% of tokens to Dedicated SKU for invoicing purposes, regardless of actual server placement. We'll add usage reconciliation at month3 to true-up.

james.sales: Example calc for month1: total tokens 1.2B. Hosted rate = $0.00002/token, Dedicated commit rate = $0.000015/token. With 50/50 split: Hosted billed tokens = 600M -> $12,000; Dedicated billed tokens = 600M -> $9,000; then apply $18,000 credit -> invoice net $3,000 (pre-tax).

billing-bot: [automated message] Invoice preview generated: INV-NE-2025-0134, gross $21,000, credits applied $18,000, net due $3,000.

aditya.legal: Draft amendment received. I redlined credit forfeiture + add clause for reconciliation and require a PO. Also added audit rights for usage logs.

marta.finance: Ok. Two finance asks before approval: (1) sign-off from RevOps on true-up math and mapping rules; (2) confirm tax treatment of pilot credit (is it a discount or marketing promo?).

leo.revops: I reviewed mapping rules. True-up plan: at month3 we calculate actual token split. If billed Dedicated > actual mapping -> issue credit or invoice the delta. Add cap: reconciliation delta limited to 20% of the pilot credit to reduce chase.

james.sales: Customer accepted cap and amendment, prefers Net30.

aditya.legal: Legal ok with amendment with cap.

marta.finance: Confirmed tax treatment with accounting: treat as sales discount (affects revenue recognition). We need GL code and memo.

marta.finance: Approving the pricing exception subject to: 1) amendment signed, 2) PO received, 3) RevOps true-up plan included. Approver: marta.finance (Finance Manager).

james.sales: Thanks — will send amendment and PO request to customer and loop back when signed. :tada:

marta.finance: Please cc billing team once signed so we can post credit in billing system.

billing-bot: [reminder] If amendment not signed within 14 days, pilot credit will expire automatically.

james.sales: noted. I'll prioritize.
